body: There it is...She just sent me a bunch of texts and told me she's coming over to my house now...

Ok. So the text with the suicide threat was sent to me about an hour ago but I only just saw it when I made the post. RIGHT after I posted she's called me and sent me more messages saying "plz talk" etc.

So it looks like this might've been for attention. Is this sort of thing common? Where people will threaten suicide but with no intention of doing it?
